label: Rosen's replication condition: replication in an (M,R)-system exists iff evaluation is one-to-one on the repairs
statement_en: In the simplest (M,R)-system A --f--> B --Phi--> H(A,B), with the hom-sets taken as predicates on function types, a replication map at a point b (a map beta from metabolisms to repairs with beta(Phi b) = Phi for every admissible repair Phi) exists if and only if evaluation at b is one-to-one on the admissible repairs. Corollaries: if every map B -> (A -> B) is admissible, B has two points and there are two different maps A -> B, replication does not exist; if only constant repairs are admissible, it exists at every b.

hypotheses.name: Delphi.Relational.EvalInjective
hypotheses.statement: Evaluation at b (Phi maps to Phi b) is one-to-one on the admissible repairs: two admissible repairs that produce the same metabolism at b are equal.
hypotheses.source: Louie (2012) Int. J. General Systems 41(1):5-22, pp. 7-9, doi:10.1080/03081079.2011.622088: the replication map is obtained by inverting evaluation 'under stringent but not prohibitively strong conditions'. Stated informally as a one-to-one condition in Letelier et al. (2006) J. Theor. Biol. 238(4):949-961, doi:10.1016/j.jtbi.2005.07.007.

scope.basis: a theorem about a model: Louie's simplest (M,R)-system, with hom-sets encoded as predicates on function types. It says nothing about whether a cell realises an (M,R)-system or which hom-sets a living system realises. Category-theoretic, lambda-calculus and process-algebra encodings are not covered, and neither is closure to efficient causation or computability.

evidence.note: A proof that the condition is necessary and sufficient in the model. No data test exists or is claimed. Claim louie2012-04 in the claim source github.com/halcyonic-systems/delphi-relational, which carries the three readings.
